title: The Sin of Eli's Sons and the Judgment on Eli's House
description: Eli's sons Hophni and Phinehas abuse the priestly service by forcibly taking sacrificial meat and sleeping with the women who serve at the entrance to the tent of meeting. Eli rebukes them, but they do not listen. A man of God comes to Eli and announces the Lord's judgment: Eli's house will lose its priesthood, both sons will die on the same day, and the Lord will raise up a faithful priest in their place.
